agents.name: backend
agents.description: Owns the HTTP API services and their business logic: endpoints, validation, background jobs and the PostgreSQL schema behind them.

agents.name: infra
agents.description: Runs the platform the services sit on: containers, deploys, CI, caching and message brokers, and the alerts that fire when they break.

agents.name: frontend
agents.description: Builds what people see and click: the web client, its components, state handling and accessibility.

agents.name: payment
agents.description: Owns money movement: charges, refunds, settlement, reconciliation and the payment provider webhooks, including their signature verification.

agents.name: qa
agents.description: Owns the test suites and the release gate: integration tests, flaky test triage and reproducing reported defects.
